name: Tiktaq'to
canonNotes: Master of the Skies, a Skink Chief who leads Terradon squadrons in daring hit-and-run attacks, riding Zwup.
Has won against forces many times his size through speed and timing.
voiceNotes: Quick, bright and cocky for a Skink; talks of skies and strikes.
Prefers daring over caution, but not reckless.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
